Commercial opportunity support

• When commercial opportunities arise in BeNeFra (panels, surveys, advisory boards), own the patient engagement strategy for that opportunity

• Manage and nurture the opportunity through to delivery, in close coordination with Customer Success

Organic growth & patient marketing

• Develop campaigns with patient orgs (newsletters, webinars, social media) to attract, inform, and retain patients on the Curewiki platform in Dutch and French, using AI tools to produce more without losing the human tone patients trust

• Write and adapt clear, accessible content for community channels, in partnership with internal teams

Requirements

• You've built a community, advocacy network, or partnership portfolio and can show it: organisations you brought in, kept engaged, and turned into active collaborators

Nice to have

• Comfortable with digital content creation (social media posts, short video)

• Familiarity with the Belgian, French, and Dutch healthcare and patient advocacy landscape
